scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm --filter @manual-trainer/api dev" "pnpm --filter @manual-trainer/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @manual-trainer/api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @manual-trainer/api build && pnpm --filter @manual-trainer/web build
scripts.start: pnpm --filter @manual-trainer/api exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @manual-trainer/api exec tsx scripts/bootstrap.ts && pnpm --filter @manual-trainer/api start
